_note: The Full Attacker Suite is the instructor's view of the offensive side of the lab. Every network action form, the ModBus data table and modify tools, the network graph, packet console, and both physical models are available at once, with the lab hack settings and admin visibility applied.

Use this page to rehearse demonstrations before class, troubleshoot the lab hardware, or act as the red team in a capstone exercise once students have finished the attacker lessons. Nothing is hidden or staged here, so it's not meant as a student's first look at any of these tools - the numbered lessons introduce them one at a time for a reason. As always, use it only against the lab network.

- Rehearse attack demonstrations against the lab hardware.
